text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Kiseki-chan, how do you draw 
your manga?"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious too! How do you come up with 
such interesting stories!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, good question! The secret is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I've read tons of interesting 
stories!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can kinda tell! What kind of 
stories are actually 'entertaining'!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I can intuitively tell what kind 
of story will get everyone hyped up—...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……I can just tell, right away which one's 
more entertaining when you compare them.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The first is a tale of miracles.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the rainy Kikuka Sho, she 
enters the Takarazuka Kinen, the ultimate 
battle to determine the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she wowed 
everyone by running as a front-runner and 
completely shutting down the closers with 
brilliant late kicks.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The second is the story of Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With her natural athletic prowess and 
extraordinary mental fortitude, she became 
the fifth Triple Tiara winner in history.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And she announced her entry into the Japan 
Cup, a race that brings together the 
world's finest Umamusume to determine 
number one. ...All for the sake of the 
next summit.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Which one sounds more fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which one would make the Japan Cup a more 
interesting race?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Which of them being the protagonist would—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Even so...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, I will surpass it! I'll create a 
"fun" that beats that fun!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (We are going to create it ourselves!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next to take the stage: Daring Tact, 
carrying the essence of Mother Nature! And 
the blooming flower of our era, Curren 
Bouquetd'or!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's such strange weather... It's supposed 
to be cool, yet... it feels so hot...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――This heat, this circle... It is all 
originating――from over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Tact & Bouquet
text_block_list.text: At the center is—that person.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Here you are, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've finally reached it. A race with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to this. To 
this showdown.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………Me too. My heart's pounding at the 
thought of beating you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(—Watching your eyes sparkle like that 
once again...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(To you, who fits the role of protagonist 
better than anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, the "Protagonist"... Almond Eye, I 
will—!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I want to overcome it and become the main 
character!!
